summary: An auditable three-condition state machine evaluated point-in-time on UTC-day intervals. It describes what has been observed in a drawdown; it does not predict or confirm a bottom.

interval.source: daily OHLC candles (codex.token-bars resolution 1D, or a validated x4o2 candle capability)
interval.note: Daily snapshot prices are point samples, not candles: they can open an episode and measure drawdown, but they never establish a held low (no observed lows).

episode.definition: At evaluation time t, peak = max(high) over the lookback intervals that ended at or before t (point-in-time). An episode opens when close(t) <= (1 - openDrawdown) x peak. Its id is <tokenId>@<peakStart>. The episode low is min(low) since the peak, using only intervals ended by t.
episode.close: The episode ends when a later interval's high exceeds the episode peak (superseded by a new high) or when no adequately observed interval exists for staleIntervals consecutive intervals (stale).

1_capitulation.name: Material realized loss-taking during the drawdown
1_capitulation.window: From the episode peak to t.
1_capitulation.formula: lossSoldShare = soldValueUsd(loss-making sales with known cost) / soldValueUsd(all sales with known cost); realizedLossUsd = sum(cost - proceeds) over loss-making sales with known cost.
1_capitulation.met: costCoverage >= 0.8 AND lossSoldShare >= 0.6 AND realizedLossUsd >= max(25000, 0.05 x mean circulating market cap over the window)
1_capitulation.costCoverage: soldValueUsd with known acquisition cost / total soldValueUsd. Coverage is by sold value, not by number of wallets returned.

accounting.costBasis: FIFO per wallet within the token.
accounting.transfersIn: Unknown cost (never zero, never inferred from the sender).
accounting.startingInventory: Balance held before the first observed trade has unknown cost.
accounting.pricing: USD value at transaction time from the trade record; current prices are never used.
accounting.fees: Proceeds and costs net of fees when the trade record states them; otherwise gross, disclosed.
accounting.sourceReportedPnl: Provider P&L, cost basis and unrealized P&L are context only and never substitute for reconstructed realized losses.

1_capitulation.insufficient: costCoverage < 0.8, no wallet-resolved trades, or an unvalidated trade capability.

2_low_holds.name: The episode low holds
2_low_holds.formula: Count consecutive adequately observed intervals after the interval that set the episode low whose low >= episode low.
2_low_holds.adequate: An interval with high, low and close present and USD volume >= 1000. A missing or thin interval resets the count; it never counts as holding.
2_low_holds.insufficient: No candles (only snapshot prices) or fewer than 3 intervals after the low.

3_absorption.name: Buying absorbs selling and first-seen buyers participate
3_absorption.baseline: The drawdown leg: intervals from the peak to the interval that set the low.
3_absorption.formula: absorption = buyVolumeUsd / sellVolumeUsd; firstSeenShare = buyers never seen buying this token before / all buyers (wallet-resolved).
3_absorption.met: absorption(after low) >= 1.2 x absorption(baseline) AND firstSeenShare(after low) >= 1.1 x firstSeenShare(baseline), each over at least 3 adequately observed intervals with flow coverage >= 0.8 of volume.
3_absorption.insufficient: No buy/sell split or no wallet-resolved buyers.

stage: Counted in order: stage = number of leading conditions met. A later condition never advances the stage while an earlier one is unmet; every condition is still shown independently.

states.not_applicable: No open episode: the coin is not in a qualifying drawdown at t.
states.insufficient_data: An episode is open (or candles are missing) but condition 1 cannot be evaluated. Never shown as 0/3.
states.stage_0: In a qualifying drawdown; condition 1 evaluated and not met.
states.stage_2: Realized loss-taking observed; the low has held.
states.stage_3: Realized loss-taking observed; the low has held; buying absorption and new-buyer participation improved.

resetPolicy: A new lower low (low < episode low) resets condition 2 and condition 3 to unmet and starts their windows at the new low. Condition 1 is re-evaluated over the whole episode window. Each reset is recorded as an invalidation in the condition history.
lookAhead: Every evaluation uses only intervals that ended, and observations that were available, at or before t. Later lows or recoveries never relabel earlier evaluations; histories are append-only per evaluation time.
labels: Descriptive only: 'Capitulation observed', 'Low holding', 'Absorption improving'. Never 'bottom confirmed', never a return probability.

changelog.summary: secondsSinceLow is measured from the close of the low's interval and is zero while that interval is still open (sample-based episodes could report a negative value). States and stages are unchanged.
